design: Weighted mean of 0–100 behavioural markers → calibrated harm probability. Weights blend a non-negative (monotonic) multivariate logistic (redundancy-aware) with univariate discrimination (so no literature-grounded marker is zeroed), fit on first-90-active-day markers → later RG-coded account closure (leakage-aware, prospective). Probability layer v2: discrete-time hazard on the index (piecewise baseline over months 1-3/4-6/7-12/13-24/25-36), reported as p(harm within 12 months).

calibration.note: Discrete-time hazard: h(month j|S) = sigmoid(alpha_piece(j) + beta*S/100); p(harm within H months) = 1 - prod(1-h). Events = RG-coded closure after the feature window; censoring at dataset end or 36 months.

caveat: Self-exclusion is an under-ascertained proxy (Catania 2021): tuned for recall, false positives expected. Three markers are literature priors (no analog in the fitting data). The calibration is fit on offline marker proxies; operators re-fit it exactly in-browser on their scored population.
